c1_escape.cross.find.speaker: steve
c1_escape.cross.find.text: She was close enough to stop me. She didn’t move.
c1_escape.cross.find.synthesis_text: She was close enough to stop me. She didn’t move.
c1_escape.cross.find.previous_text: Don’t. Please. I don’t know who you are tonight.
c1_escape.cross.find.next_text: My list: one good morning, played twice. A whistle Admiral won’t answer. A signature Nora couldn’t have made. A phone call about a notebook. A locked door.

c1_escape.ctx.02.speaker: steve
c1_escape.ctx.02.text: Her raincoat was dripping on the floor. I carried it out to hang on the balcony hooks.
c1_escape.ctx.02.synthesis_text: Her raincoat was dripping on the floor. I carried it out to hang on the balcony hooks.
c1_escape.ctx.02.previous_text: Home. Nora took a phone call in the bedroom and closed the door. She never closes the door.
c1_escape.ctx.02.next_text: Something in the lining. Soaked. Aquarium letterhead... north wing?

c1_escape.in.02.speaker: steve
c1_escape.in.02.text: Nora? The balcony door’s locked. From inside.
c1_escape.in.02.synthesis_text: Nora? The balcony door’s locked. From inside.
c1_escape.in.02.next_text: Someone signed Nora’s name in the north wing while she was at her mother’s birthday, across the bay. And now Nora has locked me out on the balcony.
